study_title: Olabode et al. (2022) Continuous-Time HIV-1 Recombination Benchmark
citation: Olabode et al. (2022) Revisiting the recombinant history of HIV-1 group M with dynamic network community detection. PNAS 119(19): e2108815119
data_provenance: Original benchmark alignments generated under Olabode et al. protocol (360 alignments: Exp 1 N=16 COMET, Exp 2 N=37 continuous-time Wright-Fisher with Gamma SRV, Exp 3 N=50,100,200 scaling)

methods_evaluated.rhizaeon: Local execution with standard workflow: PrefixDistanceEngine(compute_transitions=True) + RP-FDA screen (min_z=1.8, min_pir=0.06, crossover_gate=0.005) + ML polisher
